            cells = []

                    if 0 <= yy < h-2 and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx] == color:

    order = [g[h-2][c] for c in range(w) if g[h-2][c] != bg]

        unused.remove(i)

    for cells, next_cells in zip(sequence, sequence[1:]):
